_comment: SimHub font family -> MOZA dashboard font family, for the .djson import path.
The TARGET names are the family strings observed in real wheel-loaded dashboards
(~/dashes/*/*.mzdash), NOT the .ttf filenames in PitHouse's bin/DashboardFonts —
those differ: Arame-Mono.ttf is '0Arame', Frizon-2.ttf is 'FRIZON', manrope-*.ttf
is 'Manrope3', big-john-woff2-2.ttf is 'Big John', douyuFont.otf is 'DOUYU Font'.
Emitting a filename gives a silent fallback font on the wheel.
Matching is case-insensitive. An unlisted family falls back to 'default' and is
recorded in the conversion report so the table can be extended.

map._comment: grouped by the character being matched, not alphabetically
